Ask: one-time pilot top-up of 1,000,000 tokens + 30-day sandbox extension. If we require signed SOW/PO I can get that, but they asked if we can approve a short runway first so they can complete the evaluation.

Why approve?
- Product-fit signal: heavy usage on reranking + long-context gen — clear expansion path (estimated ARR > $250k first year if performance holds).
- Time sensitivity: procurement delay is external; losing momentum risks the deal slipping to a competitor.
- Low risk: pilot is read-only analytics; they've confirmed no production PII will be used (engineering to confirm).

Metrics (from their usage dashboard):
- Current token consumption: ~350k tokens/day during runs
- Remaining runway: ~7 days

Suggested guardrails:
- Top-up capped to 1,000,000 tokens; sandbox only, no production keys
- Need signed SOW or PO within 14 calendar days of top-up issuance
- Require confirmation that datasets are non-production / synthetic

Attachments: pilot-metrics-usage.csv, SOW_draft_v1.docx

Can you advise approval authority or escalation path? Legal (Connor) please flag any immediate concerns for the SOW.

Thanks,
Marissa
